services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: We can’t wait to see you at Dad's Garage, the comedy theatre located in an old renovated church in Atlanta’s Old Fourth Ward at 569 Ezzard Street, Atlanta, GA 30312! If you’re looking for React Theatre, you’ll still park at the Dad’s Garage main lot and walk about a block and a half to the React space at 572 Edgewood Ave SE, Suite 116, Atlanta, GA 30312. There’s a map at the bottom of this page. Scroll down and click the questions below to get all the deets on where to find us, where to park, where to eat-all that good stuff and more. Generally, Dad’s Garage has one “early” show or event every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. On Fridays and Saturdays, we host two different shows and events

services.desc: Hi. I'm Colin. I think I'm what they call an Atlanta "native", moved in at 4 from "out west". I may have desert in my bones, but the swamp is my home. I was raised by two microbiologists, so science is like, my love language. I have a cat named Cat, he didn't like his birthname so now he's nameless slob. I suppose I got into this whole "improv thing" after playing Dungeons and Dragons for years. I really enjoyed coming up with whacky voices with friends, so much so, that we started a tabletop roleplaying podcast together. I couldn't shake the notion of how cool it would be to do the same thing, but like, on a stage bigger than a dining table. That lead me to my first improv classes at Dad's

blurb: Comedy-drama The Bear won Emmys and Golden Globes for comedy, but Dad’s Garage dares to delve into the question plaguing the minds of erudite television gourmands everywhere: what if The Bear actually was a comedy? Presenting: SCANDAL!
